# Contoso Claims Hub — Operations
End-to-end view of the claims pipeline: **intake API → Event Grid → validation → Service Bus → processing → Durable approval workflow**.

Platform probes (`GET /`, `GET /health`, warm-up) are excluded from every tile.

content.title: Pipeline at a glance

content.query:
requests
| where name == "POST /claims"
| summarize Claims = count() by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Claims submitted over time

content.query:
let started = traces | where message startswith "Validating document" | extend claimId = extract(@"(CLM-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-F0-9]+)", 1, message) | summarize Start = min(timestamp) by claimId;
let workflow = traces | where message has "approval workflow started" | extend claimId = extract(@"(CLM-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-F0-9]+)", 1, message) | summarize WorkflowStarted = min(timestamp) by claimId;
started
| join kind=inner workflow on claimId
| extend LatencySeconds = round(datetime_diff('millisecond', WorkflowStarted, Start) / 1000.0, 1)
| project Start, claimId, LatencySeconds
| order by Start desc
content.title: End-to-end latency per claim: document validation → approval workflow started (seconds)

content.query:
requests
| where name !in ("GET /", "GET /health", "GET /robots933456.txt")
| summarize Calls = count(), AvgMs = round(avg(duration), 0), P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0),
            FailurePct = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 1)
          by Component = cloud_RoleName, Operation = name
| order by Component asc, Operation asc
content.title: Latency and failures by pipeline stage

content.query:
requests
| where success == false and name !in ("GET /", "GET /health", "GET /robots933456.txt")
| summarize Failures = count() by bin(timestamp, {TimeRange:grain}), Operation = name
content.title: Failed operations over time

content.query:
exceptions
| where operation_Name == "processClaim"
| extend text = strcat(outerMessage, " ", innermostMessage, " ", tostring(details))
| extend claimId = extract(@"(CLM-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-F0-9]+)", 1, text)
| where isnotempty(claimId)
| summarize Attempts = dcount(tostring(customDimensions.InvocationId)), LastAttempt = max(timestamp),
            Reason = take_any(innermostMessage) by claimId
| extend LikelyDeadLettered = Attempts >= 3
| order by LastAttempt desc
content.title: Claim processing failures (messages retried, then dead-lettered after 3 attempts)
